content: <thought>To synthesize 4,4'-dimethoxystilbene (SMILES C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2) in a single step, the classic McMurry coupling of two equivalents of p‑anisaldehyde (4‑methoxybenzaldehyde, SMILES COc1ccc(C=O)cc1) is appropriate. I located a retrosynthetic template that converts two aldehydes into a central C=C bond (McMurry coupling). I verified that p‑anisaldehyde is commercially available and inexpensive, keeping the total cost well below $150. The final route follows the required JSON schema.
